import pandas as pd

def main():
    # Define source file paths
    source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_28/test_0.csv"
    source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_28/test_1.csv"
    target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_28/target_multisource_cot.csv"

    # Load Source 0: School info
    # Schema: ['School ID', 'school_name', 'type', 'size', 'budget']
    df_school = pd.read_csv(source0_path, dtype={
        'School ID': int,
        'school_name': str,
        'type': str,
        'size': int,
        'budget': int
    })

    # Load Source 1: Student info with scores
    # Schema: ['Student ID', 'student_name', 'gender', 'grade', 'school_name', 'reading_score', 'math_score']
    df_student = pd.read_csv(source1_path, dtype={
        'Student ID': int,
        'student_name': str,
        'gender': str,
        'grade': str,
        'school_name': str,
        'reading_score': int,
        'math_score': int
    })

    # Join Source 1 (student) with Source 0 (school) on school_name to get school details including School ID, type, size, budget
    # The target schema requires 'School ID' from Source 0, so we join on school_name (common column)
    df_merged = pd.merge(
        df_student,
        df_school,
        how='left',
        on='school_name',
        validate='many_to_one'  # Each student belongs to one school
    )

    # Rename columns to match target schema exactly
    # Target schema: ['Student ID', 'student_name', 'gender', 'grade', 'school_name', 'reading_score', 'math_score', 'School ID', 'type', 'size', 'budget']
    # Columns are already named correctly except 'School ID' which is capitalized in Source 0 and should remain so.
    # Confirm all columns exist and are in correct order:
    target_columns = [
        'Student ID',
        'student_name',
        'gender',
        'grade',
        'school_name',
        'reading_score',
        'math_score',
        'School ID',
        'type',
        'size',
        'budget'
    ]

    # Ensure all target columns are present
    missing_cols = [col for col in target_columns if col not in df_merged.columns]
    if missing_cols:
        raise ValueError(f"Missing columns after merge: {missing_cols}")

    # Select and reorder columns
    df_target = df_merged[target_columns]

    # Enforce data types as per target schema
    df_target = df_target.astype({
        'Student ID': 'int64',
        'student_name': 'string',
        'gender': 'string',
        'grade': 'string',
        'school_name': 'string',
        'reading_score': 'int64',
        'math_score': 'int64',
        'School ID': 'int64',
        'type': 'string',
        'size': 'int64',
        'budget': 'int64'
    })

    # Write the result to the target CSV file without index
    df_target.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
